subject: Fix FD leak in connSocketBlockingConnect on timeout (#3541)
reason: The change only moves conn->fd = fd before the aeWait timeout check in connSocketBlockingConnect, closing an fd that was previously leaked on a connect timeout. Its sole caller is MIGRATE to an unresponsive target. The client-visible behaviour is identical on both builds: both send -IOERR error or timeout connecting to the client, free the connection, and return NULL. The only difference is a leaked kernel file descriptor, which no oracle detects (it is not a heap leak, so LeakSanitizer never fires, and there is no fd-count command/INFO field to compare).
